title: 10 Best Citrus Bergamia Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Citrus bergamia are teas, tinctures, decoctions, syrups, and capsules, each offering unique benefits for health and wellness. Tea made from dried bergamot leaves is commonly used to promote relaxation and aid digestion. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, often used for its calming and mood-enhancing properties. Decoctions involve simmering the herb to extract its active compounds, making it suitable for addressing digestive issues. Syrups are popular for their soothing effect on the respiratory system, while capsules offer a convenient and standardized form for daily use.
